result.title: CustomReport product excellence through SDLC

facts.text: The maintained CustomReport product has explicit domain and dependency boundaries, one clear owner for each cross-cutting concern, no prohibited cycles or duplicate write paths, and every behavior change is traceable to an active, strictly validated OpenSpec requirement.

All maintained production code follows one enforced style: readable naming and small focused modules, functions at most 57 lines, files at most 230 lines, cyclomatic complexity at most 10, cognitive complexity below 10, and no unclassified mutable state or local lint/style exemption. Before these stricter limits supersede the current standard, one dedicated OpenSpec change/spec is approved and strictly validated. Generated, test, fixture and externally dictated adapter code is explicitly classified rather than silently exempted.

The repository contains no unreferenced product paths, dead code, stale historical workflow, duplicate tooling or undocumented suppression in maintained scope; each candidate is removed, migrated or retained with a current source-of-truth reason.

Every applicable role, profile, route, state, control, transition and fault flow delivers correct, responsive and accessible user-facing behavior with no missing, skipped or unknown cell and no blocking functional, visual, keyboard, semantic or data-integrity defect.

The product has deterministic unit, integration, end-to-end, UAT and targeted regression tests that fail before a defect fix and pass after it; required checks cover the accepted product denominator and do not rely on waivers or historical green runs.

Delivery is observable and recoverable for product purposes: one exact source-bound runtime provides browser, API, worker, database, Redis, Loki, OpenTelemetry and Bugsink evidence; failure, Redis TOCTOU/outage and recovery behavior are proven; and isolated environment work is limited to the proof needed for those product properties.

The dedicated campaign branch has current source-bound code, test, live, review and remote evidence; required quality gates, CI and release read-back pass; and the repository, runtime and archive have no unresolved owned agent, process, port, container, volume, worktree, secret or other residue.

Product, architecture, operational and OpenSpec documentation describes the current system, its ownership and recovery paths well enough for a new engineer to make a safe change without relying on historical session artifacts.

The goal is complete only when all accepted facts are proved for one current source SHA/tree, the full applicable denominator has zero missing, skipped or unknown cells, no blocking product-quality finding remains, the independent final Sol review passes, and CR-001 required remainder is zero.
